results.name: Proper-marginal nonidentifiability of global quadratic distinction
results.statement: For rho_c=1/2(|0^N><0^N|+|1^N><1^N|)+c(|0^N><1^N|+h.c.), all proper marginals are independent of c for d>=2,N>=2, while E_{d^N}(rho_c)=d^N(1/2+2c^2)-1.

results.name: Universal proper-subsystem closure
results.statement: No universal composition map using only all proper subsystem states or ledgers can reconstruct the full quadratic distinction ledger for arbitrary multipartite states.

results.name: GHZ quantum-marginal mechanism
results.statement: Global-state nonuniqueness from lower-order marginals, including GHZ-type exceptions, is established quantum-marginal prior art.

results.name: Dimension and party stress audit
results.statement: Dense checks d=2..6 plus exact-formula sweeps d=2..12,16,24,32,48,64,96,128 and N=2..12 agree with the theorem; d=1 is degenerate.

next_surviving_target: Derive an independent PDT-native law governing irreducible N-body sector data rather than reconstructing it from proper marginals.
